heading: Yon-managed SQL and Redis
body: Configure resources as datasource and redis in server/application.json. Yon reads them as the yon.datasource and yon.redis paths. Yon creates the connections and manages them. Needs injects (gives) DataSource and RedisTemplate into stores and services in every Yon language except Lua: a Lua class that needs them stops the build with `TY2015` (ADR 0085). Browser Tac code never receives these resources or their secrets. Tachyon never creates or migrates (changes) a database schema (the tables and their columns) by itself. SQL over the network uses verified TLS (an encrypted connection with a checked certificate). A configured driver must connect successfully before the server starts. You still configure native Tac clients manually. Pass every value as a parameter, such as `query("SELECT id FROM products WHERE name = $1", [name])`: query text built by joining values stops the build with `TY1325`. Redis keys and values are always parameters.
